title: Late Prescription-Change Remake Percentage Bands — Northgate Optical
content:
**Northgate Optical late prescription-change remake percentages.** A prescription-change remake no more than 30 days past its window costs 20 percent of the base lens price, and one 31 to 90 days past its window costs 30 percent. A remake that is not past its window costs nothing; a remake more than 90 days past its window is outside these two bands.

| Days past the window | Late percentage of the base lens price |
|---|---|
| 0 or fewer (not past the window) | nothing is charged |
| 1 to 30 | 20 percent |
| 31 to 90 | 30 percent |

**Days past the window.** The calendar days from the window start, which is day 0, to the opening date of the prescription-change remake, less the prescription-change remake window of the lens design the job carries:

| Lens design the job carries | Prescription-change remake window |
|---|---|
| Northgate Single Vision Lenses | 60 days |
| Northgate Lined Bifocal Lenses | 60 days |
| Northgate Lined Trifocal Lenses | 60 days |
| Northgate Standard Progressive Lenses | 60 days |
| Northgate Premium Progressive Lenses | 90 days |
| Northgate Digital Freeform Progressive Lenses | 90 days |

The base lens price is that of the lens design the job carries.

### Band edges (hypothetical Northgate Standard Progressive Lenses job, window 60 days, base lens price 99.99)

| Remake opened on day (from the window start) | Days past | Band |
|---|---|---|
| 60 | 0 | not past the window |
| 61 | 1 | 20 percent (19.998 of the 99.99 base lens price) |
| 90 | 30 | 20 percent |
| 91 | 31 | 30 percent (29.997 of the 99.99 base lens price) |
| 150 | 90 | 30 percent |
| 151 | 91 | outside the two bands |
